---
title: "NPC chrX manuscript metrics"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
script_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
source(file.path(script_dir, "..", "_common", "project_paths.R"))
require_packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "readr", "tibble"))
source_hicbzip_core()
source(file.path(script_dir, "NPC_chrX_workflow_helpers.R"))
source(path_here("simulation", "manuscript_figure_helpers.R"))

unified_file <- Sys.getenv(
  "HICBZIP_REAL1_UNIFIED_RDATA",
  unset = path_here("data", "processed", "NPC_chrX", "list_muS_unified_260614.RData")
)
table_dir <- path_here("results", "NPC_chrX", "manuscript_summaries")
fig_dir <- path_here("results", "NPC_chrX", "figures")
ensure_dir(table_dir)
ensure_dir(fig_dir)
```

```{r load-unified-object}
require_files(unified_file, label = "NPC chrX unified processed data")
load(unified_file)

required_objects <- c(
  "list_muS_combine", "true_muS", "lambda_list", "lambda_vals",
  "sparsity_labels", "sparsity_list", "resolution"
)
missing_objects <- required_objects[!vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop("Unified object is missing required object(s): ", paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

K <- ncol(true_muS)
N <- nrow(true_muS)
expected_dim <- c(N, K)
bad_dim <- names(list_muS_combine)[!vapply(list_muS_combine, function(x) identical(dim(x), expected_dim), logical(1))]
if (length(bad_dim) > 0) {
  stop("Matrices with unexpected dimensions: ", paste(bad_dim, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
```

```{r recompute-metrics-if-needed}
if (!exists("scc_muS") || !all(c("method", "lambda", "SCC") %in% names(scc_muS))) {
  scc_muS <- npc_chrX_build_scc_table(list_muS_combine, true_muS, K, lambda_list, resolution)
}
if (!exists("IS_vector_plot2") || !all(c("method", "lambda", "IS") %in% names(IS_vector_plot2))) {
  IS_vector_plot2 <- npc_chrX_build_is_table(list_muS_combine, true_muS, K, lambda_list, resolution)
}

method_levels <- c("Raw", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)", "scHiCluster", "HiCImpute", "Higashi", "Fast-Higashi")
method_colors <- c(
  "Raw" = manuscript_base_colors[["Simulated (Raw)"]],
  manuscript_method_colors[c("HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)", "scHiCluster", "HiCImpute", "Higashi", "Fast-Higashi")]
)

scc_muS <- scc_muS |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    method = factor(.data$method, levels = method_levels),
    lambda = factor(.data$lambda, levels = paste0("ld=", npc_chrX_coverage_labels()), ordered = TRUE)
  )

IS_vector_plot2 <- IS_vector_plot2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    method = factor(.data$method, levels = method_levels),
    lambda = factor(.data$lambda, levels = paste0("ld=", npc_chrX_coverage_labels()), ordered = TRUE)
  )

scc_summary <- scc_muS |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$method, .data$lambda) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_SCC = mean(.data$SCC, na.rm = TRUE), sd_SCC = sd(.data$SCC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

is_summary <- IS_vector_plot2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$method, .data$lambda) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_IS = mean(.data$IS, na.rm = TRUE), sd_IS = sd(.data$IS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

readr::write_csv(scc_summary, file.path(table_dir, "NPC_chrX_SCC_summary.csv"))
readr::write_csv(is_summary, file.path(table_dir, "NPC_chrX_insulation_score_summary.csv"))
```

```{r scc-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
p_scc <- ggplot(scc_muS, aes(x = lambda, y = SCC, color = method, group = method)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Downsampling level", y = "SCC") +
  manuscript_theme(base_size = 11)

p_scc
save_manuscript_plot(p_scc, "NPC_chrX_SCC_all_methods", fig_dir = fig_dir, width = 8, height = 4, save_pdf = TRUE)
```

```{r insulation-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
p_is <- ggplot(IS_vector_plot2, aes(x = lambda, y = IS, color = method, group = method)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Downsampling level", y = "Insulation-score correlation") +
  manuscript_theme(base_size = 11)

p_is
save_manuscript_plot(p_is, "NPC_chrX_insulation_score_all_methods", fig_dir = fig_dir, width = 8, height = 4, save_pdf = TRUE)
```
